source_text: By the late 20th century, epidemiological data from fistula repair centers indicated gishiri cutting contributed to 2-15% of vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) cases in northern Nigeria, with higher estimates in specific locales like Kano and Sokoto states. [18] [19]
